# The armed forces are outside OEWS.
# Air & Space Forces Magazine, 2025 USAF & USSF Almanac: DoD Personnel, from
# DMDC: https://www.airandspaceforces.com/article/2025-usaf-ussf-almanac-dod-personnel/
== military, FY2024
total active duty (DMDC table): 1,280,652
  enlisted: 178,974 female + 855,183 male = 1,034,157
  officers:  48,140 female + 185,441 male =   233,581
  cadets and midshipmen: 12,914
appropriated-fund civilian full-time equivalents (thousands): 726
full-time Guard and Reserve (thousands): 92

# Police and fire are local government, which OEWS does not break out by
# function. FBI UCR, Crime in the United States 2018, Police Employee Data:
# https://ucr.fbi.gov/crime-in-the-u.s/2018/crime-in-the-u.s.-2018/topic-pages/police-employee-data
== law enforcement agencies, 2018
sworn officers: 70.4% of all law enforcement personnel
sworn officers per 1,000 inhabitants: 2.4
all full-time law enforcement employees per 1,000 inhabitants: 3.4
civilians include clerks, radio dispatchers, meter attendants, jailers, correctional officers, mechanics

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Military pay. CRS In Focus IF10532, Defense Primer: Regular Military
# Compensation, Table 1, from DOD Selected Military Compensation Tables,
# January 1, 2026: https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IF10532.html
# Regular Military Compensation is basic pay, housing and subsistence
# allowances and the tax advantage on them — what a civilian would have to
# buy out of a wage. Note the year: 2026, against OEWS's 2023.
== military pay, January 2026 (annual RMC)
E-1 private: basic 27,965; housing 23,076; subsistence 5,723; tax advantage 4,045; RMC 60,810
E-5 sergeant: basic 49,965; housing 27,121; subsistence 5,723; tax advantage 6,339; RMC 89,148
E-8 master sergeant: basic 83,807; housing 34,246; subsistence 5,723; tax advantage 5,939; RMC 129,715
O-1 second lieutenant: basic 51,289; housing 24,654; subsistence 3,942; tax advantage 5,682; RMC 85,567
O-4 major: basic 118,273; housing 39,463; subsistence 3,942; tax advantage 10,800; RMC 172,477
O-6 colonel: basic 174,534; housing 45,385; subsistence 3,942; tax advantage 14,117; RMC 237,978
